changes: Retain the same active schema generation through transient partial or zero-progress IO for both Packet and Packed owners. Only a real new request creates a pending next generation.

Genuine failed re-admission, queue eviction, explicit TX clear and route-policy retirement release the lost response owner and preserve one pending recovery. Restart header refresh and existing partial transfer identity/order remain.
Preserve the already-declared replay service priority across repeated side-owned continuation attempts; original application schema priority and reliable ordering stay unchanged.

Use two bytes of existing BoundedDeque padding for one pending/inflight owed band. Refusal retains it; an actual fragment admitted by that selected dispatch settles it. Temporary absence/inflight work permits other bands to progress.
Pass a dispatch-local admission bool through private send helpers. Reentrant/concurrent admissions on other sides cannot credit the selected callback. No global epoch or counter rollback remains.

Existing highest control band keeps its bounded8turn allowance while an ordinary band is owed. An explicit clear invalidates the owed debt while keeping the old inflight reservation until its callback returns.
